_comment: Seed fixture for the suggested-test-cases-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000001809 (free-htmx port — Phase 4 W6). Strategy A —
slug rather than replacing it. Reference ports: activity-log MR !2334
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `suggested-test-cases` renderer
{title, detail, coverage}. The Go renderer does no normalisation,
no markdown rendering, and no button construction, so this port has
no parity gaps — both paths produce structurally-identical chrome

fields.template_source:
{{- $cases := index .Payload "cases" -}} {{if $cases}}
    {{range $cases}}
  • {{if .detail}}

    {{.detail}}

    {{end}}
    • {{end}}
{{else}}

No test cases suggested.

{{end}}

cases.title: Upload a 50 MB PDF
cases.detail: Asserts the spinner clears within 30 s.
